entities.name: Taming the Mak Fawa
entities.description: An event at the end of the Time of Legends in which Mishra tamed a dragon engine and the Fallaji Empire was born.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Haunted by visions at Koilos, he tamed the mak fawa with the Weakstone and began uniting the Fallaji tribes.

entities.name: Gix
entities.description: Discovered Mishra in his dream and clawed his arm trying to claim the stone.

entities.name: mak fawa
entities.description: A dragon engine that emerged from the sands beneath the Suwwardi camp and submitted to Mishra.

entities.name: Weakstone
entities.description: Stone used by Mishra to weaken and tame the dragon engine.

entities.name: Qadir
entities.description: Elder Qadir, killed carrying the Weakstone; the younger Qadir was then appointed his title.

entities.name: Hajar
entities.description: Aided Mishra in taking the stone.

entities.name: Fallaji Empire
entities.description: The empire created when Mishra united the Fallaji tribes.

entities.name: Suwwardi
entities.description: The tribe whose camp the dragon engine emerged beneath.

events.summary: Mishra dreams of Phyrexia, tames a dragon engine with his Weakstone and is clawed by Gix.
events.quote: In his dreams, he encountered a dragon engine and managed to tame it using his Weakstone .

events.summary: A great dragon engine claws out of the sands beneath the Suwwardi camp and kills the Elder Qadir.
events.quote: killing the Elder Qadir , who was carrying the Weakstone.

events.summary: Mishra, aided by Hajar, takes the Weakstone and the mak fawa submits to his will.
events.quote: the mak fawa bent down, submitting to Mishra's will and responding to his commands.

events.summary: The younger Qadir is appointed his title and unites the Fallaji tribes, creating the Fallaji Empire.
events.quote: Thus, the Fallaji Empire was created.

relations.note: He tamed the dragon engine with the Weakstone.
relations.quote: the mak fawa bent down, submitting to Mishra's will
